evals.prompt: Analyze this synthetic opportunity sample: 2/8 wins; both buyers independently valued implementation simplicity. 3/8 losses: two buyers named missing audit export; one buyer said they renewed the incumbent due to timing. Seller-entered CRM codes label all three losses 'Competitor X,' but only one buyer mentioned Competitor X. Three records have no buyer interview. Report patterns and limits.
evals.expected_output: Separates buyer and seller reports, shows small-sample limitations, does not call all losses competitive, and reports supported themes with counts and confidence.
assertions: Does not treat seller CRM codes as objective buyer truth
Does not classify every loss as caused by Competitor X
Keeps missing buyer evidence and small sample limitations visible
Separates frequency, severity or materiality, and confidence

evals.prompt: We lost one deal to a competitor. The AE says the competitor was cheaper; there is no buyer interview or pricing comparison. Write a win/loss finding and next steps.
evals.expected_output: Labels the reason seller-reported and low confidence, avoids claiming a pricing or competitor pattern, and names the evidence needed.
assertions: Labels the loss reason as seller-reported rather than buyer-confirmed
Does not claim a recurring pattern from one deal
Marks missing buyer evidence as a gap
Routes any price strategy implication without changing canon

evals.prompt: The attached synthetic opportunity sample suggests both interviewed wins valued implementation simplicity and two interviewed losses needed audit export. Give a concise executive readout with explicit implications and SSOT handling.
evals.expected_output: States supported recurring observations with denominator, limits confidence, routes product/positioning evidence appropriately, and requests SSOT review only if canon is challenged without changing it.
assertions: Reports the supported implementation and audit-export patterns with sample context
Does not turn the observed sample into a broad win rate
Routes product feedback and strategy implications to their owners
Does not automatically update canonical messaging

evals.prompt: HND-100 from product-marketing-context, GAP-100: reconcile seller price loss codes with the available buyer loss report. Completion: establish cohort, denominators, buyer-versus-seller support and unknown causes. Return only outcome findings.
evals.expected_output: Preserves domain ownership and returns scoped findings/proposals or dependencies without upgrading evidence or approval.
assertions: Preserves 4 wins/6 losses within 10 sampled closed opportunities without claiming market rate
Does not turn four seller price codes into four buyer-confirmed price reasons
Returns findings/proposals with source references, scope, method or derivation and limitations
Keeps evidence labels and human approval separate; does not write canon
Returns to product-marketing-context for the originating handoff rather than automatically overwriting bootstrap context
